semantics.storage: Exactly eight D-type flip-flops Q[7:0] and combinational read multiplexing
semantics.shift: If enable is high at the positive edge: Q_next[0]=S and Q_next[i]=Q_previous[i-1] for i=1..7
semantics.hold: If enable is low at the positive edge, all Q bits hold
semantics.read: Z=Q[{A,B,C}] continuously, with A the address MSB and C the LSB; no clock or enable needed for read
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior
semantics.initialization: Initial Q contents unspecified; no initialization added. Eight enabled writes make all contents known
semantics.serial_order: For loading an eight-bit word, send bit 7 first and bit 0 last
semantics.read_during_shift: Z reflects updated Q after the clocked register update settles

numeric.address_encoding: Unsigned binary ABC maps 000..111 to Q[0]..Q[7]
numeric.arithmetic: No arithmetic, rounding, saturation, or accumulator; oldest Q[7] is discarded on shift

verification.oracle: Independent eight-element bit array updated in descending index order on enabled clock edges
verification.initial_state: Do not assert power-up contents; first fill with eight known bits
verification.directed: Load every possible eight-bit word MSB first; check every read address after loading
verification.timing: Check all addresses before and after rising edges, after falling edges, during enable holds, and after input changes without rising edges
verification.hold: Exercise enable=0 with changing S and addresses
verification.tools: Icarus v12 compile with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top, matching vvp; finite command and testbench timeouts

specification_ambiguities: Power-up contents are not specified, so no deterministic initialization is implemented or required by tests.
